You will start by learning key AWS Services for compute, storage, database, networking, monitoring, and security, then dive into how to design architectural solutions, how to create and operate a data lake, and how to prepare for the certification exam. Why should you get certified? The AWS Certification is one of the top-paying IT certifications, per the SkillSoft IT Skills and Salary report Opens in a new tab . Per Enterprise Strategy Group Opens in a new tab , surveyed AWS Certification holders credited their certification for their higher earnings (74%), increased confidence (87%), and increased influence among coworkers (79%). Achieving the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate certification showcases your knowledge and skills in AWS technology across a wide range of AWS services. The certification focuses on the design of cost and performance optimized solutions and demonstrating a strong understanding of the AWS Well-Architected Framework. Applied Learning Project Through 15 hands-on labs, you’ll use the AWS Management Console to apply skills learned in the videos. For example: In Architecting Solutions on AWS, you’ll use Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, Amazon SQS, Amazon DynamoDB, and Amazon SNS to build a serverless web backend. In Introduction to Designing Data Lakes, you’ll use Amazon S3, Amazon OpenSearch Service, AWS Lambda and Amazon API Gateway to create an Amazon OpenSearch Service Cluster. You’ll also use Amazon S3, Amazon EC2, Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose, Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics, Amazon Elasticsearch Service to create a data ingestion pipeline with the use of high-scale AWS Managed services. In Cloud Technical Essentials, you’ll design a 3-tier architecture using services like Amazon VPC, Amazon EC2, Amazon RDS with high availability and Elastic Load Balancing following AWS best practices. You’ll upload an architecture diagram laying out your design including the networking layer. AWS Cloud Technical Essentials Course 1 , 21 hours Course 1 • 21 hours Course details What you'll learn Describe terminology and concepts related to AWS services Articulate key concepts of AWS security measures and AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) You will learn to distinguish among several AWS compute services, including Amazon EC2, AWS Lambda, and Amazon ECS. Understand AWS database and storage offerings, including Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS), Amazon DynamoDB, and Amazon S3. Are you looking to begin working in the cloud, but don’t know where to go next? Are you looking to up your game by prepping for the AWS Solutions Architect Associate Exam? Do you see yourself as a cloud consultant, but can’t quite envision how your days would be? Are you puzzled how to match a customer’s requirements with the right AWS services/solutions? If so, you are in the right place!! You’ll learn how to plan, think, and act like a Solution Architect in a real-life customer scenario. In this course, you’ll get prepared to begin your career architecting solutions on AWS. Through a series of use case scenarios and practical learning, you’ll learn to identify services and features to build resilient, secure, and highly available IT solutions in the AWS Cloud. Each week, a fictional customer will present a different need. We will then review the options, choose the best one for the use case and walk you through the architecture design on a whiteboard. You’ll learn about event-driven architectures with a focus on performance efficiency and cost. You’ll then gain knowledge on how to architect a solution using many purpose-built AWS services. With this understanding, you’ll get a sense of hybrid architectures with a refined focus on reliability and operational efficiency. Finally, you’ll wrap up your learning by understanding a multi-account strategy centered on security and cost. Build essential skills with one of our best deals Save now Help your team rise higher Save 50% now Frequently asked questions Who is this program for? We recommend this professional certificate for individuals who are already in a solutions architect role - or aspire to one - and are preparing for their AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate exam. Typically, those preparing for this certification are IT professionals with one or more years of hands-on experience designing distributed applications and systems using the AWS Cloud. IT professionals with strong on-premises server experience looking to build their careers as cloud professionals may also be interested. Job roles that are ideal candidates for this certification include: solutions architect, SAP consultants, cloud engineer, network architects, networking engineers, and systems administrators. What background knowledge is necessary? None. The first course in this professional certificate provides foundational cloud knowledge and an introduction to a broad range of AWS Services. What is a Solution Architect? Solutions Architects (SAs, as they are known at AWS) are responsible for managing an organization’s cloud computing architecture. They have in-depth knowledge of the architectural principles and services used to develop technical cloud strategy, assist with cloud migration efforts, review workload architectures, and provide guidance on how to address high-risk issues. What does a Solution Architect do? A Solutions Architect is knowledgeable of the systems and processes to guide the broad technical design which outlines a solution’s architecture components. The solution architect offers a continual holistic view into how systems are or need to be integrated, what data silos are present and recommends technology best practices throughout the project’s lifecycle. Which certification does this prepare me for? This program helps you prepare for the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate certification. We recommend that in addition to this professional certificate, candidates review the free exam guide, sample questions, and AWS technical documentation (e.g. white papers and product FAQs) on the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate exam page Opens in a new tab to understand what content and services are covered by the exam. What will I be able to do upon completing this professional certificate? You will know how to make informed decisions about when and how to apply key AWS Services for compute, storage, database, networking, monitoring, and security. You’ll also be able to design architectural solutions, whether designing for cost, performance, and/or operational excellence, to address common business challenges. You’ll know how to create and operate a data lake with AWS Lake Formation in a secure and scalable way, ingest and organize data into the data lake, and optimize performance and costs. You’ll also know how to identify incorrect responses on the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate exam, and what your strengths and gaps are, so you can plan additional preparation before you sit for the exam. Why should I earn the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate certification? The certification showcases your knowledge and skills of AWS technology across a wide range of AWS services. It demonstrates your ability to design and implement distributed systems on AWS, following the best practices laid out by the AWS Well-Architected Framework. The AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate certification not only enhances your career profile and potential for higher earnings, but it also increases your credibility and confidence when interacting with stakeholders and customers. AWS Certified individuals have the expertise to make the right recommendations, optimizing cost and performance, to meet the technical requirements of organizations and their customers. In what languages is this certificate available? This professional certificate is available in English. How much does this certificate cost? Professional Certificate program costs range from $39-$99 USD per month. You can start with a 7 day free trial. What will I get if I complete an online certificate program on Coursera? If you complete all courses in your certificate program, you will earn a certificate that you can share with your professional network. If available, you may also be eligible for a discount voucher to take an AWS Certification exam. Please check individual certificate pages for the type of certificate issued upon program completion and if a discount voucher may be available. Does this program help me prepare for the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate certification exam? Yes, this training program can help prepare you for the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate certification exam administered by Amazon Web Services. The self-paced courses in this program are intended to equip you with the knowledge necessary to kick start your career in cloud architecture and help you prepare for the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate certification exam. How do I take the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate certification exam? You can register for this certification exam on the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate exam page Opens in a new tab . To prepare for your AWS Certification exam, we recommend that — in addition to attaining this Professional Certificate — candidates review the free exam guide, sample questions, and AWS technical documentation (e.g. white papers and product FAQs) on the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate exam page Opens in a new tab to understand what content and services are covered by the exam. Please note that while this program on Coursera can help prepare you with the skills necessary to take the certification exam, the certification and certification fee isn't included in the program's cost. You must register for the exam as a separate step when pursuing the AWS certification. Is this course really 100% online? Do I need to attend any classes in person? This course is completely online, so there’s no need to show up to a classroom in person. You can access your lectures, readings and assignments anytime and anywhere via the web or your mobile device. Can I just enroll in a single course? Yes! To get started, click the course card that interests you and enroll. You can enroll and complete the course to earn a shareable certificate. When you subscribe to a course that is part of a Certificate, you’re automatically subscribed to the full Certificate. Visit your learner dashboard to track your progress.
